mainEntity.name: What is the cost difference between various weather-resistant outdoor cabinet materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of weather-resistant outdoor cabinetry varies by material, design complexity, and brand. Marine-grade polymer (HDPE) cabinets often offer a mid-range price point, balancing durability and affordability. Stainless steel options can be at a higher price point due to material cost and fabrication, while natural woods like teak are typically the most expensive upfront due to their inherent qualities and sourcing. When making a decision, consider the practical tradeoff between initial investment and long-term maintenance needs, as some cheaper materials may require more frequent replacement or repair.
